We would know rest for our weary souls.
And we would tremble.
But not because of the trouble that faces us.
But because our victorious and conquering King has descended to this world and He is among His people and His Church in His glory is our glory.
We are safe with Him.
We can be confident in His victory.
We can rest in peace.
Do you still have no faith?
Why be afraid in the presence of the King?
Let's pray.
Father, though trouble surrounds us on every side,
though we are filled with fear, Lord,
though we will leave this room soon
and go into a week where our enemies
and sin will plague us at every turn,
Lord, we confess that You are our sovereign Lord and that to You belongs the victory in
our salvation.
So Lord, we pray that You would empower us, that You would strengthen us to be a fearless
church because we know that Your Son Jesus is with us.
That You are with us through Your Spirit.
May we encourage one another to trust in You.
May we call out to you in our fear and know that you are near.
Lord, we know nothing can separate us from the love that is ours through your son.
So Father, we pray that you would encourage us in your love now.
And in particular, we pray that you would encourage those who cannot be with us this morning,
who are a part of our church family.
Lord, encourage them in the gospel of your son.
May they rest secure in your everlasting arms.
May they know that you are a trustworthy God
and give them confidence and courage in the midst of fear.
We pray all this in Christ's name. Amen.
